highlights: The silent, wireless laser mouse of the valued Ugreen brand is a computer accessory that will be appreciated by many users of computer equipment.
The ergonomic model MU001 has been profiled in such a way that it can be comfortably used by both left and right-handed people .
In addition, it has 2 silent buttons and a fine-pitch scroll wheel . The roller also serves as a third button.
The computer mouse from Ugreen has a precise high-class sensor , the sensitivity of which can be set at one of 4 levels - 1000, 1600, 2000 and 4000 DPI .
This universal model will work both during office work, browsing the Internet, and while playing video games.
Only one AA battery is needed to power the Ugreen MU001 mouse - ()Battery not included)
